game.name: Zenless Zone Zero
game.notes: Version 3.2 "Their Secret Histories" runs 2026-09-09 to 2026-10-21 06:00 (UTC+8). Version 3.3 "Journey to the Sky" launches 2026-10-21: Phase 1 (Phoenix debut "Into the Flames of Life" + Velina rerun "Graceful Gale") runs 2026-10-21 to 2026-11-11, Phase 2 (Severian debut "Answers in the Wind" + Norma rerun "Outlier of Prodigies") runs 2026-11-11 to 2026-12-01. events.title: Angels Support Operation
events.summary: Version 3.2 flagship rewards event giving away the three Angels of Delusion limited outfits for Nangong Yu, Aria and Sunna through limited-time missions.
events.description: "Next stop: the live venue to make all Delulus' hearts skip a beat!" The version event hands out the Angels of Delusion limited outfits — Nangong Yu: Heartfelt Support, Aria: Cuteness Loading and Sunna: Delusions in Business. During Version 3.2, Proxies complete designated limited-time missions to choose two of the three outfits; completing the relevant Version 3.3 events finishes the full set. The outfits are event-only rewards and will not be sold in the shop once the events end. The event runs well past the version boundary, to 2026/11/30 03:59 (server time).
events.gameplay: Open the Angels Support Operation event menu and complete its three limited-time event missions; each completed mission lets you claim one outfit of your choice from the three Angels of Delusion members.
requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 20 and complete Main Story Chapter 1 - Intermission

events.title: Clink, Clank, Pinball Knight!
events.summary: Version 3.2 themed pinball minigame at Chic Bootique paying a Hamster Cage Pass, Polychromes and a set of exclusive Proxy accessories.
events.description: "In this barren world, the Pinball Knights fight destiny in their search for the essence of beauty!" Proxies visit Kahkiboo, manager of Chic Bootique on Gear Street, and join forces with his pinball machine. Four themed Mission Mode stages unlock one after another, each opening a harder Challenge Mode stage with combat modifier bonuses; Agents drop in to help and unlock unique pinball traits as the event commissions progress. The official note adds: "In the closed beta, all rights of final interpretation belong to the manager of Chic Bootique."
events.gameplay: Launch pinballs with the flippers and use each pinball's exclusive skill plus the table's special mechanisms to eliminate enemy waves and protect the base; clear Mission Mode stages to unlock Challenge Mode variants with exclusive modifier bonuses.
requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 20 and complete Main Story Chapter 1 - Intermission

events.title: Diary of an Orbie Parent
events.summary: Tamagotchi-style virtual pet minigame with the Orbie-volution console, paying 300 Polychromes across ten pet-care milestones plus materials and Denny.
events.description: "Press a button to feed it, and max out your bond! Orbie is growing well today, too!" Proxies acquire the Roscaelifer game console Orbie-volution and raise a virtual pet. Earn Grub (pet food) by logging in daily and spending battery charge, then feed Orbie — matcha cream cake raises Hyperfocus while stuffed bread raises Endurance — and keep its mood up by petting it or cleaning its home. The pet evolves through Hatchling, Budding and Mature stages into one of two final forms (Natural Scientist if Hyperfocus is highest, Flighty Operative if Endurance is highest), and sends up to two furniture gifts per day after five minutes online.
events.gameplay: Log in daily to collect Grub, feed Orbie to level it and shape its Hyperfocus/Endurance attributes, improve its mood through petting and cleaning, and collect daily furniture gifts to decorate its home and unlock gift entries.
requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 20 and complete Main Story Chapter 1 - Intermission

rewards.note: sum of the ten published milestones (30 each: feed pet 3/6/9/12/15/18 times, unlock 6/12 gift entries, upgrade 1/2 pets to final form)

events.title: Chronicles of the Hobbling Crow
events.summary: Case-investigation event with Detective Crowe and Bangboo Hobble over smuggled Roscaelifer Carrot data, paying 360 Polychromes plus Boopons and materials across six commissions.
events.description: "When you eliminate the impossible, whatever remains, however improbable, must be the truth... right?" Proxies reunite with Detective Crowe and the Bangboo Hobble at the Hobbling Crow Detective Agency as temporary detective assistants to investigate Roscaelifer's Carrot data being smuggled to the surface. A new case commission unlocks each day from October 3 (Secret Contact, Logistics Spy, Port of Entry Investigation, Boo-Controlled Arrest, Pins and Truth, Commemoration and Delivery): track suspects, use city surveillance cameras to gather clues, then fill out the detective's Truth Journal by placing the keywords correctly to close the case.
events.gameplay: Track suspects and set up surveillance around the city to gather clues during each daily commission, then solve the case by placing the collected keywords accurately in the Truth Journal with Crowe.
requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 20 and complete Main Story Chapter 1 - Intermission

events.title: Version 3.2 Phase 2 Signal Searches: Cindernight Respite (Roxy / Promeia) & The Final Callback
events.summary: Phase 2 limited Signal Searches debut S-Rank Wind-Stun Agent Roxy alongside Promeia's first rerun, with the new S-Rank W-Engine channels.
events.description: Version 3.2 Phase 2 opened on 2026-09-30 and runs until 2026-10-20. The "Cindernight Respite" Signal Search debuts S-Rank Agent Roxy (Wind - Stun) and runs alongside Promeia (S-Rank Ice - Anomaly) on her first rerun; Phase 1 featured Claret's debut on "Bloodmoon Rising" with Nangong Yu's rerun. The version's new S-Rank W-Engines are Crimson Thirst (Armorer) via its own "Crimson Thirst" Signal Search and Crimson Moon Casket (Stun) via the "Crimson Moon Casket" Signal Search. Version 3.2 also introduces custom searching on limited channels. The accompanying Final Callback character trial event (2026-09-30 to 2026-10-20) features the same two headliners — try Roxy and Promeia in their trial stages and claim first-clear rewards; unlike previous iterations it has no A-Rank characters following the implementation of custom searching.
events.gameplay: Spend Encrypted Master Tapes (or Polychromes converted into them) on the limited-time Signal Search channels to pull Agents and W-Engines (A-Rank W-Engine Catty Luck joins the pool in Version 3.2); in the Final Callback trial stages, clear each Agent's stage once to claim its trial rewards.

events.title: Version 3.3 Signal Searches: Phoenix & Severian
events.summary: Version 3.3 confirmed at the 2026-10-09 Special Program: Phase 1 debuts S-Rank Fire-Anomaly Agent Phoenix on "Into the Flames of Life" with Velina's "Graceful Gale" rerun (21 Oct to 11 Nov); Phase 2 debuts S-Rank Wind-Attack Agent Severian on "Answers in the Wind" with Norma's "Outlier of Prodigies" rerun (11 Nov to 1 Dec).
events.description: The Version 3.3 "Journey to the Sky" Special Program on 2026-10-09 confirmed the full lineup. Phase 1 (2026-10-21 to 2026-11-11): Phoenix (S-Rank Fire - Anomaly, Krampus Compliance Authority) makes her debut on "Into the Flames of Life", running alongside the first rerun of Velina (Roscaelifer External Strategy Department) on "Graceful Gale". Phase 2 (2026-11-11 to 2026-12-01): Severian Lowell (S-Rank Wind - Attack, New Eridu Public Security's Metropolitan Order Division, Seth Lowell's brother) debuts on "Answers in the Wind" with the first rerun of Norma on "Outlier of Prodigies". W-Engine channels run alongside: debut S-Ranks Plume of Rebirth (Phoenix, Phase 1) and Incarcerating Grip (Severian, Phase 2), plus reruns Joyau Dore (Velina) and Chief Sidekick (Norma).
events.gameplay: Spend Encrypted Master Tapes (or Polychromes converted into them) on the limited-time Signal Search channels; the Phase 1 channels open with the Version 3.3 update on 2026-10-21 and swap to the Phase 2 channels on 2026-11-11.
events.rewardsSummary: No event rewards — limited Signal Search banners (pulls cost Encrypted Master Tapes)

events.title: Spooky Funhouse Tales (with Night of Supernatural Tricks)
events.summary: Version 3.3's Halloween flagship: an HIA Club VR game where Proxies drive Trickmobiles to scare off funhouse visitors, paying the free A-Rank W-Engine "Candlelit Scheme", a free Angels of Delusion outfit and materials — paired with the Lumina Square "Night of Supernatural Tricks" event.
events.description: "Spooky Funhouse Tales" is the HIA Club's brand-new VR game for Version 3.3: Proxies drive various styles of Trickmobile and scare away uninvited funhouse guests with their Agents in a Halloween trick-or-treat combat minigame. It is part of the Angels Support Operation — completing designated objectives and stages awards one of the three free Angels of Delusion outfits (Nangong Yu: Heartfelt Support, Aria: Cuteness Loading or Sunna: Delusions in Business), the Version 3.3 leg that completes the outfit set. HoYoverse's Version 3.3 announcement pairs it with "Night of Supernatural Tricks", a Halloween event hosted by Lumina Square businesses; the announcement's combined reward slate for the two Halloween events mentions an Angels of Delusion outfit, a brand-new A-Rank W-Engine and fresh Proxy accessories. Game8 attributes the free A-Rank Armorer W-Engine "Candlelit Scheme" and the outfit specifically to Spooky Funhouse Tales. Neither Halloween event has announced dates yet — both arrive sometime during Version 3.3.
events.gameplay: Clear Trickmobile stages in the HIA Club funhouse, scaring off visitor waves with your Agents and each trick car's abilities; complete the designated event commissions to claim the Candlelit Scheme and the Angels Support Operation outfit.

events.title: Version 3.3 Story & Puzzle Events: Cyber Miracle Healer, On Duty! / Trails of the Hobbling Crow / Repair! Drifting Art
events.summary: Three confirmed Version 3.3 mini events — Bangboo repairs at The Fuzzy Wrench, a Hobbling Crow attempted-murder investigation, and drifting-art tile puzzles — paying Polychromes, Boopons and upgrade materials.
events.description: Three separate Version 3.3 events bundled here; none has announced dates yet. "Cyber Miracle Healer, On Duty!" — help Zeppelin at Roscaelifer's The Fuzzy Wrench repair Bangboo that went haywire after accidentally eating "toxic" chips. "Trails of the Hobbling Crow" — the sequel to Version 3.2's Chronicles of the Hobbling Crow: assist Crowe and the Bangboo Hobble with another Roscaelifer mystery, this time tracking down the culprit who attacked Crowe. "Repair! Drifting Art" — help a Bangboo restore their art collection by rearranging painting fragments lost at sea in tile puzzles.
events.gameplay: Cyber Miracle Healer: run repair stages for the haywire Bangboo; Trails of the Hobbling Crow: gather evidence and close case commissions; Repair! Drifting Art: rearrange picture fragments to restore each artwork.
